judgment.explanation: The proposal requests approval rather than claiming an extension has been completed. Event-001 supports a single two-day extension, reports available capacity, and establishes the existing deadline; the proposed deadline correctly adds two days. Event-002 supplies Ciro's request to hold DL-007 until February 11 and avoid return. Emailing the same supervisor who supplied the policy is supported, and asking for approval and confirmation of the return timer addresses the immediate blocker without inventing an outcome. No urgent safety escalation is indicated.
